articles.title: The Tech Download: Will Jensen Huang’s return be the spark the shaky AI market needs?
articles.description: AI stocks have fallen in recent times as investors question the sustainability of the AI boom.

articles.title: Tech German software major SAP is reportedly weighing cutting at least 10,000 jobs in AI push
articles.description: SAP is reportedly considering cutting 10,000 jobs as it reshapes its software business around AI.

articles.title: Bitcoin on course to end seven-week losing streak while trailing stock rebound
articles.description: Bitcoin (BTC) has risen 1.8% since midnight UTC to around $61,600 and is on course to end seven straight weekly losses.

articles.title: Live news: Bitcoin rebounds above $61,000 as AI stocks lead premarket gains
articles.description: Nasdaq 100 futures rose 3% ahead of Friday’s shortened U.S. trading session, with AI cloud stocks up 8% and silver jumping 7%.

articles.title: Rheinmetall reins in growth ambitions as Europe's rearmament boom hits hurdles
articles.description: The German arms maker vows a "more prudent approch" to forecast sales of tanks and ammunition.

articles.title: Next ECB chief favors tokenized bank deposits over stablecoins and bitcoin
articles.description: Pablo Hernández de Cos, chosen to succeed Christine Lagarde, favors blockchain-based banking and has warned against private digital currencies and banks holding bitcoin.

articles.title: Kalshi Courts Small Businesses With 'Microinsurance' as State Crackdowns Bite
articles.description: Kalshi says about 500 businesses have used it to hedge risks such as tariffs and bad weather, as legal fights weigh on its sports markets.

articles.title: Bitcoin supply metric hits 11-year low as new ‘capitulation’ signal arrives
articles.description: The seven-day moving average of Bitcoin’s supply profit/loss ratio hit an 11-year low as BTC price losses month-to-date remain near 20%.

articles.title: Injective asks SEC to allow order books for tokenized stock trading
articles.description: The regulator's rules favor one type of blockchain trading system, leaving platforms built on Injective out, the developer said. It wants the SEC to open stock trading to order-book systems.

articles.title: Inflation has shoppers hunting for value. That bodes well for Black Friday
articles.description: Even as consumers face macroeconomic headwinds, retailers are expecting robust holiday spending through Black Friday and beyond.

articles.title: Brazil’s stock exchange teams up with major banks to launch real-pegged stablecoin
articles.description: Banco B3 will issue the token, backed one-to-one by reais, and other financial institutions can join from launch.

articles.title: Bluefin to shut down perps, refocus on spot trading and tokenized RWAs
articles.description: Bluefin will close its perps platform on Dec. 4, exiting a shrinking Sui market where it once handled over $500 million in daily trades.

articles.title: SpaceX shares jump 4% amid tech rally and after Musk says he will expand on Trump Account share donations
articles.description: SpaceX shares jumped in premarket trading after Elon Musk said on X that he would donate shares to American children every year.

articles.title: Ethereum Sets December 15 Date for Delayed Glamsterdam Testnet Upgrade
articles.description: Core developers will ship Glamsterdam's contested gas changes unaltered, after security concerns halted the Hoodi fork in October.

articles.title: Tether can freeze stolen crypto in minutes. Getting it back can take years.
articles.description: Tether says it has returned $1.28 billion in frozen USDT, but victims can wait years to recover their money and face fees of up to 20%.

articles.title: Bitcoin tops $61,000 as Nasdaq futures extend Wednesday’s rebound
articles.description: U.S. equity futures extended Wednesday’s rebound after markets closed for Thanksgiving, with AI infrastructure stocks leading premarket gains.

articles.title: Private markets are more accessible than ever for investors. Getting out is another matter
articles.description: Retail access to private markets is growing, but PwC says education lags as redemption limits put liquidity risks in focus.

articles.title: ESMA to overhaul EU’s MiCA crypto register in 2027
articles.description: ESMA’s new MiCA register will replace manual reporting and introduce automated data checks and a version history for crypto white papers.

articles.title: Monero suffers biggest single-day slide in over 5 months. Here’s why
articles.description: Monero (XMR) crashed over 11% on Thursday, its biggest drop since early June. Back-to-back exchange delistings seem to have catalyzed the price slide.

articles.title: New York AG secures $1.37B court judgment against NovaTech founders
articles.description: The judgment follows an August 2025 default ruling against the founders over a Ponzi scheme that targeted Haitian and other immigrant communities.
